notes: 582 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/lunar/inventory/. Exalted: The Lunars supplied and inventoried cover-to-cover (341 rows): the core innate powers, every Charm category in Chapter Five (pp. 122-193/PDF 125-196: Shapechanging I/II/III, Body Enhancement I/II, Unarmed Combat I-V, Melee Combat I/II, Ranged Combat I/II, Defensive I/II/III, Survival and Healing I/II/III/IV, Perception I/II/III/IV, Stealth, Interaction and Knowledge/Presence I/II/III/IV, Spirit, and Sorcery-access Charms), and all of Chapter Four: Traits (pp. 94-115/PDF 97-118): the altered Backgrounds (Artifact, Backing, Followers, Manse, Mentor), the new Backgrounds (Cult, Heart's Blood, Renown) plus a Regions sidebar, all three player Castes (Full Moon, Changing Moon, No Moon) and the Casteless state (this edition has three Castes, not the five-Caste structure from later editions), the universal Caste anima effects and Lunar Anima Banners table, the Great Curse (this splat's Limit-Trait analog) and its four Virtue-linked thralls, and the Face/Renown social-rank system. No dedicated Lunar-specific Merits/Flaws subsection or Tribe write-up exists in Exalted: The Lunars itself -- confirmed absent, not merely unreviewed. That gap is now filled by a second source: the Exalted Players Guide's Chapter One, "Merits and Flaws" (pp. 18-41/PDF 21-44), fully transcribed as 88 rows (44 merits + 44 flaws) applicable across all five planned Exalted families, with Lunar-specific eligibility/cost caveats (Lunars-only Chimera; Celestial-Exalted-only Known Anathema/Permanent Caste Mark/Greater Curse/Throwback; Abyssals-and-Ghosts-only Death-Taint, not applicable to Lunars) captured in each row's notes. A later pass added the cross-splat sorcery/artifice supplements Savant and Sorcerer and Book of Three Circles (220 more rows, reusing terrestrial-circle-sorcery/celestial-circle-sorcery as the enabling prerequisites, and adapted from this project's already-verified Exalted: The Sidereals transcription of the same two books): the complete Chapter Five Terrestrial/Celestial Circle spell catalog (84 selectable spells), a 102-entry Hearthstone catalog (15 from Savant and Sorcerer plus 87 from Book of Three Circles' Chapter Six 'long roll'), a 13-row Artifice and Enchantment catalog (rules framework rows, two named Merits including the moonsilver-relevant Moonsilver Initiate, a Magical Materials reference, a freshly-read Lunar-specific 'In-Game Creation: The Lunar Exalted' row, and 5 selectable Sample Artifacts), a 13-row Warstriders appendix (rules framework, all five warstrider design classes as selectable equipment -- including Royal, explicitly attested to First Age Lunar pilots -- weapon-catalog references, and the moonsilver-native Proteus Gauntlet artifact), and an 8-row skim of Chapter One (Magical Theory, including a freshly-read Lunar-specific 'No Moons' initiation-monopoly sidebar) and Chapter Four (Practical Summonings). Per this project's Solar Circle Sorcery eligibility rule, no Circle of Adamant content was inventoried for Lunars. A later pass added 12 rows from the Exalted Storyteller's Companion: six Lunar-specific Charms embedded in Chapter Two's narrative (Tentacles, Summon Wild Beasts, Acid Spit, Mighty Thews, Strides of the Panther, and the Counting Coup social custom) and six universal cross-splat Sample Artifacts from Chapter Four transcribed here as the master copy for later derivation into the other four families (Ghost Cestus, Sling Bow of Ice, The Golden Viper, Land Ship, Singing Staff, Eye of Autochthon). A final pass added 9 more rows (573 -> 582) freshly transcribed from a sixth source book, Savage Seas, whose Chapter Four "Artifacts of the Waves" section (printed pp. 123-127/PDF 124-128) is a universal, non-splat-restricted naval-artifact catalog: Cargo Preservation Spindles, Armor of Aquatic Puissance, Steelsilk Sails, Storm Sapphire, Cord of Winds, Wavecleaver Daiklaive, Light Implosion Bow, Lightning Ballista, and a reference-only Artifact Ship Weapons summary table, adapted from this project's already-verified Abyssal/Sidereal transcriptions and spot-checked against freshly rendered source pages, with no Autochthonia-style setting caveat needed since Lunars are native Creation-dwellers. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Only the untriaged cross-splat supplements beyond the Players Guide/Savant and Sorcerer/Book of Three Circles/Storyteller's Companion/Savage Seas remain. Locked pending schema/rules/creator/editor implementation and passing tests across all five planned families. A final cross-splat supplement-triage pass added 16 rows (582 -> 598) from Exalted: Blood and Salt: a Lintha-connection Character Backgrounds reinterpretation sidebar, a Bluehaven approach-navigation rule, four regional Character Concepts lists, seven new Artifacts (including the Talisman of the Cult of Dukantha, which grants Infernal sorcery access), one new Hearthstone (Jewel of Stability), three mundane equipment items, and two new Terrestrial Circle spells (Song of the Lintha, Water's Ally); the rest of the book's NPC/monster stat-block material was reviewed and confirmed out of scope, and four reprinted artifacts (plus, where applicable, a reprinted Hearthstone and two reprinted/superseded spells) received citation notes on their existing rows rather than new duplicate rows.
